Description 
Porsche 911 Targa | 1975 
Highlights: 
– 2.7-liter 6-cylinder engine
– 5-speed manual transmission
– Turbo rear spoiler
– Black upholstery with red piping 
A 1975 Porsche 911 Targa with a sporty and timeless character. Since its introduction in 1963, the 911 has grown into the icon of Porsche and became beloved by enthusiasts thanks to the distinctive air-cooled six-cylinder boxer engine in the rear section, the unmistakable silhouette lines, and the pure driving feel. This Targa is powered by the 2.7-liter six-cylinder boxer engine, coupled to a five-speed manual transmission that offers the characteristic, direct shifting feel for which the 911 is known. The air-cooled power unit is clearly visible in the engine bay, complete with the imposing cooling fan so typical of this generation. This specific car is a fun, honest driver’s car with signs of wear here and there, showing that the vehicle has been used for what it was intended for: driving and enjoying. 
The car is finished in striking red paintwork that beautifully accentuates the classic, sleek lines of the Targa. The removable Targa top with the characteristic wide roll bar gives the car its unmistakable silhouette, while the wide rear section with turbo rear spoiler ensures a sporty, powerful appearance. The car sits on black Fuchs wheels, an absolute classic that perfectly suits the character of this 911. At the rear, the familiar PORSCHE lettering adorns the space between the taillights. The interior features black upholstery, beautifully trimmed with red piping that provides a subtle, sporty nod to the red exterior. Behind the characteristic steering wheel, you will find the classic round gauges with the central tachometer, while the manual gear lever invites you to hit the road immediately. The whole exudes the authentic, purist atmosphere of the early 911.
